title: Jade: Mind, Body & Song Album Cover
coreRelationships: The three women are the primary subjects, arranged in a slightly staggered line.
The typography is overlaid on the women, integrating with their forms.
The white clothing and light background create a high contrast with the dark hair and boots.
The stylized 'JADE' text dominates the upper half of the typography, with 'MIND, BODY & SONG' as a subtitle.
